items.name: Dr. Khalid Al-Harbi
items.title: Consultant Cardiologist
items.qualifications: MBBS, FRCPC (Canada), Saudi Board of Cardiology
items.bio: Dr. Khalid specialises in preventive cardiology and heart failure. He trained at the University of Toronto and has led cardiac rehabilitation programmes for over a decade.

items.name: Dr. Sarah Al-Qahtani
items.title: Consultant Obstetrician & Gynecologist
items.qualifications: MBBS, MRCOG (UK), Arab Board of Obstetrics & Gynecology
items.bio: Dr. Sarah leads our antenatal care programme with a special interest in high-risk pregnancy and minimally invasive gynecological surgery.

items.name: Dr. Omar Farooq
items.title: Consultant Orthopedic Surgeon
items.qualifications: MBBS, FRCS (Orth), Fellowship in Sports Medicine (Germany)
items.bio: Dr. Omar focuses on arthroscopic knee and shoulder surgery and helps athletes return to sport with tailored rehabilitation plans.

items.name: Dr. Noura Al-Otaibi
items.title: Consultant Pediatrician
items.qualifications: MBBS, Saudi Board of Pediatrics, Fellowship in Pediatric Allergy
items.bio: Parents love Dr. Noura's calm, reassuring style. She has a special interest in childhood asthma, food allergies and early development.

items.name: Dr. Faisal Al-Dosari
items.title: Consultant Prosthodontist & Implantologist
items.bio: Dr. Faisal combines digital smile design with implant dentistry to restore function and confidence.

items.name: Dr. Lina Haddad
items.title: Specialist Dermatologist
items.qualifications: MD, Arab Board of Dermatology, Diploma in Aesthetic Medicine
items.bio: Dr. Lina treats chronic skin conditions and pigmentation, and performs laser and rejuvenation procedures with a natural-looking approach.

items.name: Dr. Ahmed Siddiqui
items.title: Consultant Internist & Endocrinologist
items.bio: Dr. Ahmed runs our diabetes and thyroid clinics and has helped thousands of patients achieve long-term control of chronic conditions.

items.name: Dr. Maha Al-Shehri
items.title: Consultant Ophthalmologist
items.qualifications: MBBS, Saudi Board of Ophthalmology, Fellowship in Cornea & Refractive Surgery
items.bio: Dr. Maha specialises in cataract and refractive surgery and is passionate about early screening for diabetic eye disease.
